headerDisplay: Fetches temperature and humidity from SwitchBot devices via the OpenAPI v1.1, calculates the Discomfort Index, and exposes it to HomeKit. Get your token and secret from the SwitchBot app: Profile → Settings → tap App Version 10 times → Developer Options.

updateInterval.title: Update Interval (seconds)
updateInterval.description: How often to poll the SwitchBot API (30–3600 seconds, default 60)

enableScale.title: Add a scaled trigger accessory
enableScale.description: Register an additional accessory that exposes (DI − offset) × scale. The base accessory still shows the raw DI; this extra one lets HomeKit automation thresholds (which step in increments of 0.5) target a finer DI granularity.

scale.title: Scale factor
scale.description: Factor multiplied with (DI − offset) on the scaled accessory (e.g. scale 10 makes one HomeKit 0.5-step equal 0.05 DI).

offset.title: Offset (DI baseline)
offset.description: DI value subtracted before scaling, to shift the band of interest toward 0 so the result fits HomeKit's 750 trigger cap (confirmed on iOS 26.5; e.g. offset 60, scale 10 maps DI 60→0 and DI 75→150). Largest representable DI is offset + 750 / scale.
